plan.purpose: Exact image libubus C caller: candidate registration daemon vs exact image C daemon
plan.statistical_unit: One ratio per physical paired window; 20 equal-size serial segments per side are aggregated. Ten independent router windows; segments are not independent replicates.
plan.preflight: Exact-image C caller smoke passed first. Run ten fresh windows after R100 Rust-caller series and final health. Each window validates exact image shared-library hashes.
plan.production: stock C throughout; only new disposable namespace processes are pinned; no governor/IRQ/production affinity changes
plan.failure_rule: Stop on identity, correctness, collection, health, affinity or cleanup failure. Preserve failed window; never infer success from missing results.
plan.design: Two independently started subject daemons pinned CPU 1; one serial client pinned CPU 0. Ten quartets alternating slot ABBA/BAAB, 2000 untimed warmup cycles per segment. Randomized candidate/baseline slot assignment per window and randomized comparator order per suite block. This co-resident comparison is diagnostic, not full-system latency/memory acceptance.
plan.previous_data: C caller single-window smoke only; no pooling with Rust caller series.
plan.comparison_family: One comparator x four metrics; exact rank intervals at the frozen family level.
plan.slot_semantics: The runner uploads the logical slot b ELF as candidate and slot a ELF as before-candidate. The workload starts slot a on the first daemon and slot b on the second, so process roles are randomized by block. implementation=rs is only the upload path.
plan.interpretation_rule: Candidate is supported for this exact C caller condition only when every relevant interval direction is assessed. No whole-system claim, memory claim, or pooling with Rust caller results.

limits: Exact-image C libubus caller only; one ratio per independent router window, segments not independent. No pooling with Rust client series.
